title: Audio Index Format
description: Schema for index.json audio mappings. `meta` and each file's `pitch_pattern` are not read: `meta` repeats `yomitan_index.json` and where the files sit, `pitch_pattern` writes `pitch_number` in another notation.

headwords.description: Maps a headword (term) to an array of audio filenames. A name that is not a key of "files" is skipped; the import warns once with the count. A headword holding `〓` or `{CID…}` (a glyph the source could not write) is skipped; the import warns once with the count.

files.description: Maps an audio filename to its reading and pitch metadata.

kana_reading.description: The reading of the term. A file without it, or with it empty, has no reading.

pitch_number.description: The downstep position as a string of digits ("0" heiban), stored with the pattern computed from the reading, one letter per mora. `?` means unknown: no pitch is stored, without a warning. A number without a reading or past the reading's morae, or a value that is not digits, stores no pitch: the recording is kept and the import warns once with the count.
